scripts.dev: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:selfhost: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.selfhost.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.selfhost.jsonc

MAIL_DOMAIN.description: Domain that receives mail (MX + Email Routing catch-all). Example: `mail.example.com`.

PUBLIC_ORIGIN.description: Public origin of this Worker, including `https://`. Used in sample mail and hostname checks.

HOSTED_MODE.description: `true` only for the public demo on email.lomvic.com. Self-host: `false`.

TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Public Turnstile site key ([create a widget](https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/get-started/)). Dummy `1x00000000000000000000AA` for local.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Turnstile secret. Store with `wrangler secret put TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`. Dummy `1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA` for local.

AGENT_API_KEY.description: Admin/fleet bootstrap secret. **Not** the public agent path. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
